gloss: to pull down; to drag down; to withdraw (money)

definitions.gloss: to pull down; to drag down from a high position
definitions.explanation: To physically pull or drag something or someone down from a higher place.

definitions.gloss: to force someone out of a position; to topple
definitions.explanation: To remove someone from a position of power or authority, often forcefully or against their will.

definitions.gloss: to withdraw money from a bank account
definitions.explanation: To take money out of a savings or bank account. A common everyday usage.

examples.japanese: {棚|たな}から{箱|はこ}を{引|ひ}き{下|お}ろした。
examples.english: I pulled the box down from the shelf.

examples.japanese: {馬|うま}から{引|ひ}き{下|お}ろされた。
examples.english: He was dragged down from the horse.

examples.japanese: {重|おも}い{荷物|にもつ}をトラックから{引|ひ}き{下|お}ろすのに{苦労|くろう}した。
examples.english: I had trouble pulling the heavy luggage down from the truck.

examples.japanese: {社長|しゃちょう}を{引|ひ}き{下|お}ろす{動|うご}きがある。
examples.english: There is a movement to oust the company president.

examples.japanese: {国民|こくみん}の{怒|いか}りが{独裁者|どくさいしゃ}を{引|ひ}き{下|お}ろした。
examples.english: The anger of the people toppled the dictator.

examples.japanese: チームの{監督|かんとく}を{引|ひ}き{下|お}ろそうとする{声|こえ}が{高|たか}まっている。
examples.english: Calls to remove the team's manager are growing louder.

examples.japanese: ATMでお{金|かね}を{引|ひ}き{下|お}ろした。
examples.english: I withdrew money from the ATM.

examples.japanese: {毎月|まいつき}{給料|きゅうりょう}の{一部|いちぶ}を{引|ひ}き{下|お}ろして{貯金|ちょきん}している。
examples.english: Every month I withdraw part of my salary and save it.

examples.japanese: {旅行|りょこう}の{前|まえ}に{銀行|ぎんこう}から{現金|げんきん}を{引|ひ}き{下|お}ろしておいた。
examples.english: I withdrew cash from the bank before the trip.

notes:
A compound verb from {引|ひ}く (to pull) + {下|お}ろす (to lower, bring down). Transitive verb (takes を). The physical sense (pulling something down) extends naturally to the figurative sense of removing someone from power, and the financial sense of withdrawing money.

TRANSITIVITY: transitive (paired with no standard intransitive form)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {棚|たな}から{引|ひ}き{下|お}ろす: to pull down from a shelf
- {権力|けんりょく}の{座|ざ}から{引|ひ}き{下|お}ろす: to drag down from a position of power
- お{金|かね}を{引|ひ}き{下|お}ろす: to withdraw money
- {預金|よきん}を{引|ひ}き{下|お}ろす: to withdraw savings

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {引|ひ}き{出|だ}す: to pull out, to withdraw -- more general; also used for money
- {下|お}ろす: to lower, to take down -- simpler form without the pulling nuance
- {引|ひ}きずり{下|お}ろす: to drag down forcefully -- more emphatic and aggressive
